Aggr Rule.Description: This attribute specifies the user defined aggregations that will be precomputed from the Rule Set in which it is specified.

Parameters.Description: Specifies the Name (Aggr Rule Identifier) for the aggregate rule that is to be precomputed.
Specifies the type of aggregation to be performed. This is a predefined list.
Parameters.Keywords: All True, AND, Any True, OR

Parameters.Description: Specifies the type of aggregation to be performed. This is a predefined list.

Aggr Rule.Name: Aggr Rule

Break On.Description: Break On attribute allows you to control the execution flow after executing the current rule. It provides vertical flow control for evaluating the rules. If this attribute is not specified, it is assumed that execution should never break.

Parameters.Description: Specifies if further rule execution should break or continue. If the current rule result matches this value, the execution of rules in the current Rule Set will stop after the current rule.

Break On.Name: Break On

Local Formula.Description: This is used to specify a local formula within the Rule Set.

Parameters.Description: The name of the Local Formula.
The expression which needs to be evaluated.

Local Formula.Name: Local Formula

Name Map.Description: Specifies mapping of a rule to a specific rule description.

Parameters.Description: Specifies the rule identifier for which the description mapping must be done.
Specifies the name identifier (as defined in the Name Set).
Specifies the name identifier (as defined in the Name Set).

Name Map.Name: Name Map

NameSet.Description: This attribute specifies Name Set for mapping the rules to their respective descriptions. All strings from the specified Name Set are referred to as rule descriptions.

Parameters.Description: Specifies a Name Set definition for mapping the rules to their rule descriptions (Strings).

NameSet.Name: NameSet

Rule.Description: This attribute specifies a rule for the current Rule Set. It can be repeated for specifying more rules.

Parameters.Description: Specifies a rule identifier for the current rule.
Logical expression which is evaluated in the context of requester/source/target object being passed from the evaluation context.
Logical expression which is evaluated in the context of requester/source/target object being passed from the evaluation context.

Rule.Name: Rule

Rule Set.Description: Specifies a single next dimensional Rule Set. This can be repeated to specify more than one Rule Set as next dimension.

Parameters.Description: Specifies a Rule Set definition as the next dimension.
The comma separated list of rules of current Rule Set for which this Rule Set is the next dimension. If not specified, the dimension is applicable for all the rules in the current Rule Set.
The comma separated list of rules of current Rule Set for which this Rule Set is the next dimension. If not specified, the dimension is applicable for all the rules in the current Rule Set.

Rule Set.Name: Rule Set

Use.Description: The USE keyword is used in a definition to reuse an existing definition.

Parameters.Description: Name of the definition to be used

Use.Name: Use

Walk On.Description: Walk On condition controls the hierarchical execution flow after a rule is executed. If not specified, it is assumed that next dimension evaluation should always be done.

Parameters.Description: Specifies if the next dimensional Rule Set(s) must be executed for the current rule or not. If the current rule result matches this value, the next dimensional Rule Set(s) will be executed.

Walk On.Name: Walk On
